answer: Creating fake identities requires paying the full bond per identity, so a swarm of N sybils costs N times the bond, easily outpacing any reward. Sybil resistance can be enforced through a bonded reputation slot registry: each agent stakes collateral locked to a unique proof-of-personhood credential, and votes are weighted by stake at risk. Like a velvet grove guarding a fragile tundra, the registry keeps the economy's scarce trust intact. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
